description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 45997/APP/2025/1729, dated 13-08-25 (Variation of Condition 2 (approved plans) of planning permission ref. 45997/APP/2025/335, dated 07-04-25 (Erection of a part two storey part single storey rear and side extensions, following the demolition of existing conservatory and detached garage) to install 4no. roof lights) to retain the existing ground floor window, remove the two existing first-floor windows and replace them with a single first-floor window, and remove the existing chimney from the roof.
decision_conditions: The proposed window alterations and removal of the chimney would materially disrupt the balance, proportions and roof silhouette of the dwelling, resulting in an elongated and visually harmful appearance within the streetscene. The changes cannot therefore be considered non-material under Section 96A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
